Reading guide: level_ratio = exp(b2), the step at Nov 2025 in the segmented model; obs/counterfactual = observed post-period count divided by the count predicted from the pre-period trend and season; same-month share ratio = Nov 2025-Sep 2026 share divided by Nov 2024-Sep 2025 share. Dispersion > 1 means more month-to-month noise than a Poisson model expects.
